# Test photos

Synthetic faces, no real people: from SFHQ-T2I (David Beniaguev, MIT licence), images made with
FLUX.1-schnell (Apache-2.0) or SDXL (CreativeML Open RAIL++-M), downscaled to 768 px.

- `hair-over-eye.jpg` — hair falling across one eye
- `sunglasses.jpg` — dark sunglasses
- `hand-over-mouth.jpg` — fingers in front of the mouth
- `profile.jpg` — a head turned to the side (SDXL)
- `small-face.jpg` — a small face in a three-quarter-length photo (SDXL)
- `deep-skin.jpg` — very deep skin, front-on (her own makeup reads on every skin tone)
